# TAG Heuer

> > Swiss luxury watchmaker renowned for precision chronographs, motorsport heritage, and iconic collections including Carrera, Monaco, and Autavia.

TAG Heuer, founded by Edouard Heuer in Switzerland, has been a pioneer in watchmaking innovation since 1860, with deep roots in motorsport timing and racing partnerships. The brand is part of LVMH Swiss Manufactures SA and continues to produce high-performance timepieces from La Chaux-de-Fonds.

## Key Topics

- Swiss watchmaking
- Carrera collection
- Monaco chronograph
- Autavia heritage
- Racing partnerships

## Iconic Watch Collections

- [Vintage TAG Heuer Autavia Collection](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/coleccion-vintage/vintage-tag-heuer-autavia.html): TAG Heuer Autavia vintage collection including limited editions
- [Vintage Heuer Monaco Collection](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/coleccion-vintage/vintage-heuer-monaco.html): Vintage Heuer Monaco 1969 with first automatic chronograph Calibre 11
- [TAG Heuer Carrera Sailing Complication Skipper](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/coleccion-carrera/carrera-sailing-complication.html): Carrera Sailing Complication Skipper nautical chronograph collection
- [Vintage TAG Heuer Formula 1 Collection](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/coleccion-vintage/vintage-tag-heuer-formula-1.html): TAG Heuer Formula 1 Vintage quartz chronographs since 1985
- [Vintage Heuer Monza](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/coleccion-vintage/vintage-heuer-monza.html): Vintage Heuer Monza 1976 commemorating Niki Lauda F1 championship

## Vintage Heritage Timepieces

- [Vintage Heuer Montreal](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/coleccion-vintage/heuer-montreal.html): Vintage Heuer Montreal 1970s chronograph with Calibre 12 movement
- [Heuer Camaro Vintage](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/coleccion-vintage/vintage-heuer-camaro.html): Heuer Camaro Vintage late 1960s manual-wind Valjoux chronograph
- [Vintage Heuer Solunar](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/coleccion-vintage/heuer-solunar.html): Vintage Heuer Solunar 1970s tide indicator tool watch

## Racing Partnerships & Collaborations

- [TAG Heuer Porsche Formula E Team](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/colaboraciones/tag-heuer-porsche-formula-e-team.html): TAG Heuer Porsche Formula E Team collaboration in electric racing
- [Carrera Panamericana Partnership](https://www.tagheuer.com/ad/es/colaboraciones/carrera-panamericana.html): TAG Heuer partnership with Carrera Panamericana racing since 1991
